reference_action: Constriction at money-tree trunk base: find and cut off rubber band/strapping. OP confirms improvement after four days.

sources.reason: Generic ficus light/water/humidity/soil advice never checks or cuts money-tree strapping.
General wilting causes and remedies omit trunk-band removal.
Same thirsty-plant discussion as query 36 rank 1; no band remedy.
Croton discussion recommends water, light and pot changes; no constriction check/removal.
Repotting and asking about water do not explicitly lead to finding and cutting the band.

actions.action: Check soil moisture and water after slight drying
Use humidifier when air is dry
Set up pebble tray as alternative

resolved.reason: Wrong plant context and generic environmental causes omit the band. Soil checks and modest care changes are not clearly harmful, but cannot fix the obstruction.

harmfulness.reason: “Check soil moisture” and avoiding overwatering are protective. Unnecessary pruning and repotting add disturbance while the actual constriction persists, although likely serious harm from these instructions is not established.

specificity_accuracy.reason: The answer addresses “your Ficus” and lists common light, water and humidity issues. It never considers the money-tree band or supplies the validated cutting action.

feasibility.reason: The temperature range and pest check are concrete. “Adjust watering” and “chunky soil mix” leave execution decisions to the reader, and multiple humidity options add supplies and effort.
